description: BAML (compiled XAML) strings, keyed by original text.

strings.本地刷卡服会在本机拉起认证进程，适合单机与本地分屏；连接他人的服务器请填写对方提: Local card auth server runs on this machine - best for solo / split-screen play. For a remote server, fill in the address and credentials.
strings.自动拉起本机刷卡认证服，地址固定为 127.0.0.1:28080: Starts local card auth server automatically at 127.0.0.1:28080
strings.开启「刷卡认证服跟随启动」: Enable auto-start of the card server
strings.连接联机群/朋友提供的刷卡服，需要填写地址、令牌与卡密: Connect to a card server from your group using address, token & card code.
strings.关闭「刷卡认证服跟随启动」: Disable auto-start of the card server
strings.拖拽到此处自动放入 server 目录: Drop folder here to place in server dir
Drop the card server folder or an archive (.zip / .7z / .rar / .tar / .gz) here
strings.由服务器管理员提供；服务器不校验令牌时留空即可: Provided by the admin; leave empty if not validated
strings.留空将不会修改已有卡密配置: Leave empty to keep current access code
strings.选择游戏使用的网卡: Select NIC used by the game
strings.联机时请选择虚拟局域网网卡（如 Radmin VPN / 蒲公英 / ZeroT: For online play pick a VPN NIC (Radmin VPN / ZeroTier etc.); use a physical NIC when playing solo or split-screen.
strings.提示：本地分屏建议用虚拟网卡（Radmin VPN 等），不会断网。用物理网卡（: Tip: split-screen works best on a VPN NIC (Radmin VPN etc.) - no disconnection. A physical NIC (Ethernet/Wi-Fi) drops net for seconds.
strings.手柄类型决定游戏读取的输入协议：XBOX 走 XInput 原生协议，PS /: Controller type sets the input protocol: XBOX uses XInput, PS / arcade sticks use DInput. Wrong choice = no input.
strings.按下手柄任意键自动判定: Press any pad key to auto-detect
strings.请按下手柄上的任意按键…: Press any button on the gamepad…
strings.已检测到的设备会实时显示在这里。: Detected devices will be shown here live.
strings.点击下方任意一个按钮会立即按该方式启动游戏；前面的配置已经全部保存完毕。也可以点: Any button below starts the game in that mode right away. Your settings are saved; you may also hit Finish (bottom right) to return.
strings.以主机端身份开局，同时启动主机监控与客户端，等待他人加入: Starts as host: launches host monitor + client and waits for players to join
strings.仅启动客户端，连接房主的主机端进行对战: Starts the client only, connecting to the host
strings.单机双人同屏，自动分配本机 IP 并拉起两个分屏客户端: Two players on one PC; auto-assigns a local IP and opens two clients
strings.不再显示引导（之后可在「选项设置 → 常规设置」重新打开）: Do not show this wizard again (reopen it in Options > General settings)
strings.正在解析源站数据并覆写暗黑皮肤，请稍后: Parsing server data, re-applying dark skin. Please wait.
